name: Okta: Privileged Users with Old Passwords (Indirect)
description: Finds users whose last password change was more than a year ago and hold privileged role assignments through group membership.
query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.password_changed IS NOT NULL AND datetime(user.password_changed) <= datetime() - duration("P365D")
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000
